newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Tiara says Q1 net sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Bank Tiara says Q1 net sharply up.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Tiara said it posted net profit of 15.01 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 8.31 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Bank Tiara said in a statement received on Friday that earnings per share for the first quarter of 1997 was 83 rupiah compared with 46 rupiah in the year-ago period.
The bank said it posted a net profit of 41.06 billion rupiah in 1996 against 33.29 billion rupiah in 1995.
The bank said net interest income rose to 27.40 billion rupiah for the first quarter of 1997 against 20.93 billion rupiah in the same period last year.

"The first quarter of 1997 was truly a momentous quarter for Bank Tiara, marked by record earnings and significant improvement in ROE," president director Hendrick Kolonas was quoted as saying in the statement.
The statement said the bank's return on average equity (ROE) was 21.65 percent in the first quarter of 1997 against 13.41 percent in the year-ago period.
Bank Tiara operates 31 branches in six major Indonesian cities with its focus on the middle commercial market segment.
